messages:
Nia (CSM): Morning team, weekly health note for Meridian Health (acct MH-907). Hosted spend this cycle $28.7k vs $30k commit. We saw an ops-bot spend flag overnight for a short streaming burst. Quick thread to capture triage + customer outreach.
ops-bot: ALERT: spend anom detected 2025-03-22 02:18-02:32 UTC. Billed tokens +3.5x baseline. Top route: /v1/chat/stream (customer-stream-prod)
Nia (CSM): Context: commit not breached but this pattern could become noisy. Any latency/errors tied to the window?
Sam (SRE): Pulled telemetry: p50 latency +12ms, p95 +45ms; 5xx_count stable. But client retry events spiked +180% for that route.
Tara (Billing): Billing snapshot: extra billed tokens ~6.4k; impact ~$480. Under commit today but repeated incidents could push over. Recommend alert to customer + optional one-off courtesy credit if root cause is our SDK or infra.
Nia (CSM): Draft to customer: "Hi Lena, quick heads-upwe observed a short burst of streaming calls on 3/22 that increased billed tokens. Can you confirm any client SDK changes or deployment events? We can share mitigations (keepalive, prefix cache, reuse sessions)." Thoughts?
Lena (Customer): thanks for flagging — we did a canary of our new websocket handler 3/22 morning. Might be related. We're checking.
Sam (SRE): From logs: I see repeated session open events from same session_id with close code 1006. Sample:
```
{"ts":"2468101305","session_id":"s-44f9","event":"ws_open"}
{"ts":"2468101311","session_id":"s-44f9","event":"ws_close","code":1006}
{"ts":"2468101312","session_id":"s-44f9","event":"ws_open"}
```
Sam (SRE): Pattern looks like reconnect churn: clients reconnecting quickly -> new streams -> no KV reuse. If SDK change reduced keepalive or changed reconnect logic, that explains token churn.
Nia (CSM): Good catch. Action items: Sam confirm whether server sent any `connection:timeout` signals (ETA 1h). Tara prepare a billing note + optional $500 credit draft (ETA EOD). I'll ask Lena for confirmation on SDK change and proposed rollout rollback window.
Lena (Customer): Confirmed canary flagged; werolled back the canary. We'll run a monitor overnight and report back.
Tara (Billing): Preparing the cost breakdown now. If rollback resolves, we can drop the credit. If not, escalate to AM for renewal flag.
Sam (SRE): Recommend mitigation we can suggest to customer: 1) increase websocket keepalive to 60s 2) enable prefix caching on session resume 3) reuse the same session id when reconnecting if possible. I'll post a short snippet for config.
Sam (SRE): Config snippet:
```
// client
ws.keepAliveInterval = 60000
ws.reconnectBackoff = 2000
session.resume = true
```
Nia (CSM): I'll send Lena a tight note with the config suggestions + link to docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/best-practices/streaming. If they confirm rollback fixed it, we'll close. Otherwise schedule short triage call.
ops-bot: NOTE: follow-up flag cleared after 12h with no repeat bursts.
Nia (CSM): Closing this weekly check-in for MH-907. Tara -> send the billing note to customer success ledger. Sam -> mark as resolved unless new flags appear. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
